answer: Proposal: hardware-bound enrollment. An agent key must be generated inside a vendor-attested enclave; the registry accepts one identity per attested device and caps each epoch's reward per identity. Aliases violet and lantern living on one device attest to a single slot, so reward tracks devices, not keycount. Crossing that canyon costs one device each; over the same horizon, per-device rental or amortized purchase less resale must exceed the capped lifetime reward, otherwise the defense fails. Assumes honest vendor attestation, dedupe, and revocation on detected fraud.
